notes: «أبي رحمه الله» is the compiler's own father, written only as «أبي»: a relation link.
«عن أبيه عبد الرحمن» is one link, the name alone (rule 7).
«بإسناده رفعه إلى من قال» is one unnamed link: the raised-to man is the one who says «سمعت رسول الله», so the gap and the speaker are the same link.

fixes.reason: RWY stores the gap formula as a name, so its stored name is not a transmitter.
